assets.name: simple-closed
assets.note: Small clean closed control mesh — the sanity baseline. Any quality regression here is a real one, not an artifact of ugly input.

assets.name: anime-girl
assets.note: Dense (~390k vert) Meshy-style character. Needs the decimation pre-pass (solve) to be tractable. CURRENTLY FAILS extraction (extract_no_lattice: the organic detail folds the parametrization past the fold gate) — this is the dense-character failure mode the filtering plan exists to fix, so it is the headline target for the later tiers, not a clean baseline.
